vagas.title: Accounting Operations
vagas.description: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.     Role Overview   You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.    You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.     Responsibilities     Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.    Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.    Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.    Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.    Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.       Qualifications     6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.    Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness    Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;    Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;    Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus     Problem solver and first-principles thinker  with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.     Curious, fast learner  with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.     Hands-on, can-do attitude , willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.     Proven change agent  with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.     Strong communicator and collaborator  who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.    Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!
